metadata.description: kwin-mcp-warden marketplace — kwin-mcp (KDE Plasma 6 Wayland desktop GUI automation) with a warden: Claude asks first through a consent card, access is granted one window at a time, and a stop key (Meta+Alt+Esc) ends it at once.

plugins.name: kwin-mcp-warden
plugins.description: Bundles the kwin-mcp-warden MCP server (kwin-mcp with a warden: Claude asks first through a consent card, access is granted one window at a time, stop key Meta+Alt+Esc) plus the kwin-desktop-automation skill that teaches session-mode selection, the observe-act-verify loop, element refs, US-QWERTY vs Unicode typing, held input, and platform pitfalls (global logical coordinates, QMenu invisibility, EIS edge limits, clipboard opt-in).
